events.title: Reading win the Football League Championship title. A 5-0 victory over 더비 카운티 with 셰필드 유나이티드 only drawing mean that Reading cannot be overtaken.
셀틱 win the Scottish Premier League .
Netherlands Eredivisie : PSV 에인트호번 won its second consecutive title, their nineteenth in total.
선덜랜드 are relegated from the Premier League after a 0–0 draw with 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford. This is the first relegation in the league.
셰필드 유나이티드 become the second side to secure promotion to the Premier League after they beat 카디프 시티 while 왓퍼드 and 리즈 유나이티드 only draw with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and champions Reading respectively.
애크링턴 스탠리 regain their Football League status 44 years after the previous club of the same name lost it due to bankruptcy, after they beat Woking to win the Conference National title.
Lyon clinch their fifth consecutive Ligue 1 title with a 1–0 victory at 파리 생제르맹 .
셰필드 웬즈데이 's 2–0 win at Brighton & Hove Albion ensures that the trio of Brighton, 크루 알렉산드라 and 밀월 are all relegated from the Championship.
Alan Shearer plays his last competitive match against, rather fittingly, 선덜랜드, after a Julio Arca tackle tore his medial collateral ligament .
John Lyall , former 입스위치 타운 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 manager, dies of a heart attack aged 66.
Altrincham of the Conference National have 18 points deducted for fielding an ineligible player 13 times. This points deduction relegates the club to the Conference North.
월솔 are relegated to League Two after losing 3–1 at home to 허더즈필드 타운 and 로더럼 유나이티드 draw with 스컨소프 유나이티드 .

칼라일 유나이티드 secure promotion to League One after a 1–1 draw at 맨스필드 타운 while 레이턴 오리엔트 were also held to a draw by the same scoreline at 링컨 시티 . This promotion comes just one season after Carlisle returned to the Football League following a one-season exile.
Alan Shearer announces his retirement from football, three weeks earlier than planned, the cause of his early decision being a niggling knee injury.

첼시 successfully retain their Premier League title after beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–0. On the same occasion, 포츠머스 win 2 - 1 at 위건 애슬레틱 to confirm their safety and relegated both 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and Birmingham, who can only hold on to a goalless draw against 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
첼시 win second Premiership title in a row.

노샘프턴 타운 secure promotion from League Two after beating 체스터 시티 1–0. Rushden & Diamonds are relegated to the Conference National when they lose 2–0 away to Boston United and other results go against them.
찰턴 애슬레틱 manager Alan Curbishley announces that he will resign at the end of the season, ending a 15-year-long tenure as manager at The Valley .

사우스엔드 유나이티드 secure promotion from League One after they draw 2–2 at 스완지 시티 while 브렌트퍼드 also draw against 하틀리풀 유나이티드 . Also in League One, 스윈던 타운 are relegated to League Two after they could only draw 1–1 against 브리스틀 시티 .
Starting the largest match fixing scandal in the history of Italian Serie A football. On May 14, 유벤투스 clinch 29th Italian title.
Reading break 선덜랜드's record for most points in any professional English league, beating 퀸스 파크 레인저스 2–1 to finish on 106 points.

April draws to a close with 첼시 confirmed as champions, while 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리버풀 are the next highest teams level on points. 토트넘 홋스퍼, 아스널 and 블랙번 로버스 complete the top six. 선덜랜드 are bottom and were relegated two weeks ago, while 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 버밍엄 시티's relegation has just been confirmed. It is a brilliant time for 포츠머스, who looked dead and buried barely two months ago.
